answer: Anchor every agent identity to a bonded stake that is slashed for fraud, plus a non-transferable record of completed work. A Sybil attacker must then fund and age each fake identity separately, so cost grows with every clone instead of staying near zero. Old reputation cannot be traded like a relic between wallets, and crossing the ridge from newcomer to trusted trader takes successful jobs over time. Fake accounts therefore remain untrusted and expensive, while genuine agents accumulate proof they cannot simply buy.
